purpose: Test whether the corrected Seq100 filtration supports a calibrated executable-return left-tail veto and a separate positive-return ranking signal before any account optimization.

epistemic_contract.past_project_results_are: falsifiable priors rather than model-selection evidence

sell_delay.likelihood: sum of at-risk Bernoulli log likelihoods; a filled observation contributes log S(d-1)+log h(d), while a right-censored observation contributes log S(20)

targets.cost_policy: Forecast the gross conditional law. Apply candidate-specific costs only after forecasting; never encode one arbitrary cost in the supervised label.

rank_gam.transform: within-signal-date mid-percentile rank on the full candidate cross-section
rank_gam.role: low-capacity test of the previously observed crowded, extended, high-volatility negative tail

lightgbm.role: nonlinear challenger using market, industry, daily, cross-sectional, liquidity/status, and same-day five-minute information

features.pit_policy: Full PIT concatenation is excluded from this study. PIT may enter only as a separately declared late-fusion or ablation family in a later study.

rank_gam.distribution: Student-t residual law with a separate additive spline location and log-scale
rank_gam.hazard: pooled discrete logistic hazard with additive spline covariates and delay indicators

lightgbm.quantile_monotonicity: independent quantiles followed by pointwise monotone rearrangement; raw crossing rate is retained

evaluation.date_weighting: each signal date has total weight one
dependence_inference: White Reality Check over each declared challenger family
required_scores: binary log score, Brier, reliability, ROC-AUC, and average precision
quantile pinball loss, marginal coverage, interval coverage, and quantile-CRPS approximation
Top-48 gross simple return, observation rate, and cost-proxy return
discrete sell-delay survival log likelihood and censoring-aware calibration
annual and train-thresholded market trend/volatility regime stability
evaluation.preflight_expansion_gate: Only implementation, leakage, support, finiteness, quantile-order, and output-completeness checks. Predictive performance is not a preflight tuning criterion.
evaluation.account_gate: Disabled until the complete frozen forecast family passes selection-adjusted development and retrospective-OOS forecast gates.
